from trades import load_trades, ROWS
from paging import all_pages, page_count


def test_last_items_present():
    pages = all_pages(list(load_trades()), 4)
    assert sum(len(p) for p in pages) == len(ROWS)


def test_exact_fit():
    assert page_count(6, 3) == 2
    assert len(all_pages(list(load_trades())[:4], 2)) == 2
